pages.text: The Seal of Kadesh is the true beginning of this mod. Once equipped, its nine curses unfold in sequence: random afflictions, a Luck penalty, experience and trade taxes, Guilt, item locks, dimensional curses, Nether backlash, and Hunger Debt.$(br2)It is not merely a trinket. It is the master switch for the entire progression path.

pages.title: Seal of Kadesh
pages.text: Hold Shift for the narrative description of every curse, Ctrl for exact values, or Alt for dynasty lore.$(br2)The seal will not tell you how to escape. It only imposes the price; the route out must be uncovered through progression.

pages.title: Curse II: Crown of Regency
pages.text: While the Seal of Kadesh is worn, Curse II continuously lowers Luck based on cumulative wear time. Villagers encountered within the configured radius are always converted into zombie villagers.$(br2)Villager infection can be disabled and its detection radius configured. After Curse II is reversed, infection stops, the Luck penalty becomes a bonus, and the crown may still send brief loyal retainers.

pages.title: Curse VII: End Judgment
pages.text: Entering the End permanently awakens its judgment. By default, one effective killing attack is randomly chosen within every 1-to-7 cycle, and that kill produces no loot.$(br2)Marked enchanted weapons are also checked once for enchantment erasure when they enter the player's inventory.

pages.title: Config and Enchantments
pages.text: Enchantment erasure is enabled by default at 35%. Experience and materials are consumed first, while the enchanting interface only registers a pending server-side check. The roll occurs once the weapon actually enters the player's inventory, without modifying the item or options inside the enchanting interface. Enchanted weapons generated in loot chests follow the same inventory-entry rule.$(br2)Curse VII's no-loot trigger limit, enchantment-erasure toggle, and erasure chance are configurable, and the seal's Ctrl tooltip shows their current values.

pages.title: Suggested Progression
pages.text: $(li)Equip the Seal of Kadesh and learn the basic cost of all nine curses.$(li)Handle Guilt, Purification Scrolls, and Satiety Crystals so you can survive the journey.$(li)Search Nether structures for Embers of Duat and learn to read their inscriptions.$(li)Complete the ember trial, then craft the Heart of Duat and seek the remaining regalia.$(li)Once enough reversals are complete, Curses III and IV are finally lifted.

pages.title: How to Use This Book
pages.text: This guide is divided into four paths:$(br)$(li)Prologue & Overview explains the seal, the nine curses, and reversal progression.$(li)Relics & Regalia records major utility and combat items.$(li)Rites & Recipes covers crafting, dimension triggers, and special procedures.$(li)Embers & Inscriptions is dedicated to the Ember of Duat and its trial.$(br2)For a quick start, read this entry, Reversal Marks, the Ember trial, and the Relic Compendium first.
